node: Sulphur and sulphuric acid feedstock chokepoint for copper, nickel, fertilizers, and industrial acid
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around sulphur/sulphuric-acid scarcity into one reference user and three underfollowed second-order names. The strongest direct exposure found in this pass is Hawkins as a US bulk chemical distributor explicitly handling sulphuric acid. Kirby is a logistics bottleneck hypothesis for bulk liquid and agricultural chemicals, while CVR Energy is a recovered-sulfur/refining byproduct hypothesis. Mosaic is included as a reference anchor because it is a large phosphate producer whose sulphur input costs can validate the severity of the chokepoint, but it is more likely a margin-squeezed user than a beneficiary.
